title: Pilotism
summary: PI'LOTISM PI'LOTRY, noun Pilotage; skill in piloting. [Not used.] PI'LOUS, adjective [Latin pilosus. See Pilose.] Hairy; abounding with hair. 1. Consisting of hair.
